title: Hex dependency limited to one environment
description: mix.exs declares a dependency that is compiled only in `dev` or `test`. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a dependency that is compiled only in `dev` or `test`.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a dependency that is compiled only in `dev` or `test`.
limitation: It matches a dependency that is compiled only in `dev` or `test` in the parsed mix.exs; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
